design:
Deploy HTGR Sim v1 as a **static GitHub Pages demo** with no simulation
backend — computation happens entirely in the visitor's browser.

**Filed after, and dependent on, the execution-architecture refactor.** Do not
implement Pages deployment until the execution split has landed; the point of
the split is that the browser build has real parallelism rather than being a
serial fallback.

## Target pipeline

```
checkout -> test native/reference behaviour -> build Rust Wasm
         -> build/package egui web frontend -> package JS worker coordinator
         -> browser smoke tests -> static Pages artifact -> deploy
```

## Why static hosting constrains the architecture

GitHub Pages **does not serve COOP/COEP headers**, so `SharedArrayBuffer` and
shared-memory wasm threads are unavailable. That is precisely why the worker
protocol is specified to work with ordinary `postMessage` and transferables —
the hosting constraint drove the architecture, not the other way round.

## Relationship to existing work

**This overlaps `op-eeqw` / GH #39 Phases 5-9** (web shell, rAF pacing, bundle
size, deploy with responsible-use caveats). **Reconcile rather than duplicate**
— the likely resolution is that those phases are absorbed here, or this issue
becomes their parallel-execution successor. That is a maintainer call.

Carry forward `op-eeqw.9`'s requirement: **mandatory responsible-use caveats on
the page itself**. Per `RESPONSIBLE_USE.md` this is an offline demonstration
with **no human V&V claimed**, and a public URL makes that disclosure more
important, not less.

`op-eeqw.8` (measure and reduce bundle size / load time — **report honestly**)
also applies and should not be quietly dropped.

## Acceptance

- A visitor loads the page and runs the simulation with **no backend**.
- **Multiple workers demonstrably execute concurrently** in the deployed build,
  not merely in CI.
- Browser smoke tests gate deployment.
- Responsible-use caveats visible on the page.

**Branch:** `develop`. Do not merge or push to `main` as part of this work.
title: HTGR Sim v1: static GitHub Pages deployment (browser-parallel, no backend)
